# Director of Care
DoC shift objectives:
1) Ensure the health and well-being of the sector's populace.
2) Foster collaboration and coordinate efforts of medical teams where possible.
3) Encourage medical mentorship, either personally, time permitting, or by finding appropriate placement for interns.
4) Compensate medical teams for their work in assisting with the above three goals.
## Your Ledger
To compensate medical teams and station staff you have been provided a discretionary fund.
Nanotrasen is prepared to provide additional resources for the successful return of each medical bounty.
## Standard Operating Procedures
1) The Director of Care is expected to maintain their medical dispatch as a primary responsibility, including its general hygiene and habitability.
2) The Director of Care is not expected to remain at the Medical Dispatch Center. They are encouraged to be present where needed and act in a capacity that best fulfills their primary goals.
3) The Director of Care is permitted to engage in medical rescues as they see fit; however, they are advised to defer such work to other medical vessels.
4) The Director of Care is not permitted to spend dispatch funds on the acquisition of medical bounties via the medical cargo orders console. However, they may purchase such bounties using funds from their personal account.
5) The Director of Care is not permitted to distribute medical supplies of a higher tier than those offered by vendors without receiving compensation.
6) The Director of Care is required to ensure that any botanical areas set up on their dispatch are kept free of loose produce when not in use.
